query: select l.id as course_id, l.created_at as course_created_at, l.updated_at as course_updated_at, l.title as lesson_title, l.description as course_description, l.is_active as course_is_active, l.content is not null and length(trim(l.content)) > 0 as course_has_content, c.id as chapter_id, c.title as chapter_title, sub.name as subject_name, lv.name as level_name, s.name as series_name, coalesce((select json_agg(json_build_object('id', e.id, 'title', e.title, 'created_at', e.created_at, 'is_published', e.is_published, 'is_active', e.is_active) order by e.created_at) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id = l.id), '[]'::json) as exercises, coalesce((select json_agg(json_build_object('id', q.id, 'title', q.title, 'created_at', q.created_at, 'is_published', q.is_published, 'is_active', q.is_active) order by q.created_at) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id = l.id), '[]'::json) as quizzes from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id = l.chapter_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id = c.subject_id left join public.levels lv on lv.id = c.level_id left join public.series s on s.id = c.series_id where l.content ilike '%commentaire de texte%' or l.description ilike '%commentaire de texte%' or l.title ilike '%commentaire de texte%' order by l.created_at asc limit 20;
